assignments.title: Oscillatory replacement
assignments.task: Prove a useful replacement for the false pointwise |t|^-1/2 bound over arbitrary bounded densities. Preserve a phase-aligned density counterexample, then attack an averaged-in-frequency or distribution-function estimate relevant to the full coupled quadratic form.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Integrated Fourier estimate
assignments.task: Attempt a uniform bound on integral |E exp(it X^T A X)| dt under the exact three-large-eigenvalue hypotheses, without assuming pointwise decay. If it fails, produce a source-valid counterexample to this stronger Fourier criterion and continue on bounded density itself.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Decoupled time integral
assignments.task: Use the independent-copy identity for |phi(t)|^2 while retaining the dependence between sums and differences of each coordinate pair. Prove an integrated estimate that can recover linear small-ball scaling.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Product Fourier rearrangement
assignments.task: Use decreasing rearrangements and product-space inequalities rather than pointwise Fourier decay. Derive a new estimate for a genuinely rotated indefinite quadratic form with constants explicit.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Quadratic coarea bound
assignments.task: Attack sup_y integral_{Q=y} prod f_i/|grad Q| by coarea or an equivalent interval bound, preserving arbitrary product densities. Prove a uniform geometric inequality or identify a precise missing factor.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Curved fiber integration
assignments.task: Retain ellipse/hyperbola geometry within spectral fibers. The integral of unrestricted fiber sup can grow with n, so avoid replacing curved intersections by fiber maxima. Prove a weighted replacement using product structure.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Coordinate minor selection
assignments.task: Investigate a dimension-free averaging or selection of coordinate minors that exploits three large absolute eigenvalues. A single tiny principal minor is insufficient; track determinant weights through conditioning.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Diffuse eigenvector case
assignments.task: Prove an actual estimate when large eigenvectors are delocalized across coordinates, with a mechanism that complements localized-coordinate conditioning and works without moment assumptions.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Bilinear block mechanism
assignments.task: Use a disjoint coordinate partition and conditional linear anti-concentration to handle the off-diagonal part. Prevent losses from square-root decoupling and connect the result to an O(interval length) bound.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Rank-three coupled case
assignments.task: Attack arbitrary rank-three symmetric forms with all three nonzero eigenvalues of magnitude at least1, independent bounded-density coordinates and arbitrary orientation. Do not assume projected coordinates remain independent.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Indefinite signatures
assignments.task: Develop a uniform argument for genuinely rotated signatures (+,+,-) and (+,-,-), retaining the opposite-sign rank-two logarithmic control example. Identify how the third direction removes the singularity.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Additional eigenvalue control
assignments.task: Prove a valid reduction or stability theorem for adding arbitrary smaller and larger eigenvalues of either sign. The new quadratic remainder is dependent after rotation and cannot automatically be treated as independent convolution.
assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Extremal product laws

assignments.method: analytic derivation and exact structural identities
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.method: alternative proof mechanisms and complete-argument integration
assignments.acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.

assignments.title: Projection-product interaction
